response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS acc_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS acc_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acc_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(acc_bal) AS avg_balance FROM acc GROUP BY region), r2 AS (SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS mean_amt FROM reg) SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, avg_amount * 1.0 / mean_amt AS ratio_to_mean FROM r2 WHERE mean_amt IS NOT NULL AND mean_amt <> 0
